Subject: POC trial planning - Clearlake Health

Hi Sarah —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed set of next steps for the POC/trial so we can align on success criteria, timeline, and ownership: 

1) Success criteria (proposed)
   - End-to-end latency under 350ms P95 for the core clinical search flow
   - >= 95% accuracy on entity extraction against your test set (we'll need the annotated sample)
   - Confirmed integration with your API and no impact to daytime production traffic

2) Evaluation plan
   - Redwood will run a two-week trial against a copy of your staging dataset.
   - We'll run defined prompts and collect latency, token-cost, and quality metrics.
   - We'll provide a short eval report at the end with recommendations (quantization profile, batching).

3) Timeline (proposed)
   - Week 1: Data sample share + environment access (you)
   - Week 2: Redwood infra + integration work (Aditya owning infra support)
   - Week 3-4: Trial run and monitoring
   - Week 5: Results review / decision point

4) Ownership (draft)
   - Infra & connectivity: Aditya Rao (Redwood) / Tom Ellis (Clearlake)
   - App integration & test harness: Marissa Cole (Redwood) / Sarah Patel (Clearlake)
   - Security & compliance review: Lauren Bishop (Redwood) / Clearlake security team
   - Procurement & contracts: Clearlake procurement (procurement@clearlakehealth.com) with Redwood finance

I'll attach a short spreadsheet with the proposed success criteria to make it easy to edit. Can you confirm the Clearlake stakeholder list above and whether the proposed timeline looks achievable? Also please confirm which environment (staging or dedicated VPC) you prefer for the trial.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and aligned with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Stakeholders (internal):
  - App/product owner: Sarah Patel (me) — will own acceptance criteria
  - Infrastructure/Platform: Tom Ellis (VP Infra) — will own VPC/networking and access
  - Security: Ashwin Rao (InfoSec) — will own security review and SOC2 evidence requests
  - Procurement: procurement@clearlakehealth.com — will handle SOW/PO

- Environment: Tom prefers a dedicated staging VPC for the trial due to data sensitivity. If Redwood supports VPC peering or a private endpoint, that would be ideal.

- Timeline: The proposed timeline looks fine but we have a weekend blackout (maintenance) during Week 2: Feb 16-18. If we can keep infra setup in the first half of Week 2, we should be OK.

I'll loop in Ashwin separately for security details once you share the data handling plan.

Also, can you confirm what level of logs/audit events Redwood will retain during the trial? That will be needed for our security sign-off.

Appreciate the clear plan — happy to sync on a 30-min call next week to confirm owners.

— Sarah
